name: D-Squad's Maxillipede shuttle
description: A Maxillipede shuttle was captured by the Galactic Republic and used to carry out a mission. The leader of the mission was Colonel Meebur Gascon, and the crew was made up of several droids, who were called the D-Squad. The ship had CIS markings, and it was painted in the "traditional" Separatist colors white and dark blue/purple. It also has places for astromech droids to go and make external repairs to the ship.
